scenes.summary: Iron Boatswain invites you to meet him at Eternal Wall before the memorial service. He is about to secretly carve Rusty Hook's name on the wall when he realizes that someone has already done so.

lines.text: You've arrived, everyone! I'm thinking about carving Ah Gou's name on this.
A special tool may be needed to engrave a name on the stone face. Boatswain, we can submit an official application to Captain Mi on your —
No! No way! Please don't!
They're Wulingers ... and we're ... we're Stockaders. We're different. This whole thing is just a mess.
...Yes. I understand.
I actually wonder if you can, uh, use those fancy Endfield tech and help me out...
Boatswain, your brother's actual name —
Zhenggou. Jiang Zhenggou. Zheng is our generation name. So you found a way to engrave his name?
Oh? Look here, your brother's name is already on the wall.
Wha...? Really?! Lemme see. By Talos, that is his name! Is there another Wulinger with the same name?
Now that's weird. Because "Rusty Hook" is engraved right after it...
...Who did this?! When did it happen?!
It looks newly inscribed. Endmin, any ideas?
Oh, it must be her...
Mi Fu is truly a righteous soul. You gotta thank her properly if you see her during the service.
Are you saying that madam captain of the watchguards carved my brother's name on this wall?
Does that mean ... people are gonna remember him too?
Yes. He has been inscribed with the heroes of Wuling. He shall be remembered by many.
Rusty, you made it. You're a true hero now...
People said that everyone who fell for the city will get their names carved on Eternal Wall...

options: Not many people know Rusty's real name.

r: Not many people know Rusty's real name.

lines.text: Every soul who rests here gave their life for Wuling.
The fact that they rest here proves there is something they held dearer than their own lives —
Honor, duty, and virtue. Death has not defeated them.
In fact, they have emerged triumphant.
Let us pay our respects to the deserving victors.
